text:
Ava: Quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR (link in the PR description) that touches the security/audit-logs page. Main asks: adjust SOC 2 phrasing around retention and add a short, safe SDK example for listing audit events. Please focus on privacy-safe examples (no real PII).

Sam: Looking now. Two quick nits from first pass: 1) examples still have things like `user.email: alice@example.com` — we should redact or replace with `<redacted>`. 2) avoid words like 'permanent' or 'forever' in retention section. Maybe say "retained for up to X days by default". :eyes:

Ava: Good call. Draft snippet I put in PR:```json
{
  "event_type": "login",
  "user_id": "<redacted>",
  "ts": 1670000000000
}
```
I also added this sentence under retention: "By default, audit logs are retained for 365 days; retention can be configured by enterprise customers per contractual agreement." Want legal to confirm exact default/value.

Raj: @Ava thanks. From a controls/law perspective (SOC 2) we should not assert any single default retention across all customers — better to phrase generically and surface the default as an "operational default" rather than a product guarantee. Suggested phrasing: "Audit logs are stored by default for 365 days; customers with specific compliance needs can request extended retention through support or their account team, subject to contractual terms." Also add a line about encryption and access controls: "Logs are encrypted at rest and access is limited via RBAC and audit trails."

Elena: I'll reword to Raj's suggestion and remove the hard 'per contractual agreement' bit until legal confirms. Also I'll swap the JSON snippet to show scrubbing:```js
// SDK example: list audit events and scrub emails before logging locally
const events = await redwood.audit.list({ since: '2024-01-01' });
const safe = events.map(e => ({ ...e, user_email: '<redacted>' }));
console.log(safe[0]);
```
Is that enough?

Sam: That looks fine. One more SDK nit: in the JS snippet please call out the `page_size` param so internal teams don't copy a naive unpaged loop. e.g. `redwood.audit.list({ since: '2024-01-01', page_size: 100 })`.

Ava: Filed a tiny follow-up commit that: 1) swaps the example to Elena's scrubbed sample, 2) adds `page_size` to the snippet, 3) changes the retention paragraph to Raj's wording and adds the encryption/access sentence. PR link: (internal). Can LegalBot trigger a review label?

LegalBot: automated: This thread has been flagged for legal review. Please add @Raj to the PR reviewers.

Raj: Assigned. Two legal micro-asks: (a) replace "encrypts at rest" with "encrypted at rest using customer-segregated keys where applicable" for Private deployments, and (b) do not include specific retention numbers in public docs for Dedicated/Private without product consent. We can keep the example default for Hosted only.

Elena: OK — I'll scope the sentence to Hosted: "Hosted customers: audit logs are retained by default for 365 days; Dedicated/Private retention varies by deployment and contract." I'll also add a small callout box: "Contact your account team for retention options" so customers don't assume parity.

Sam: LGTM. Quick link fix request: the PR currently points to /docs/security/audit-logs#retention but the anchor was renamed to `retention-policy` last week — I pushed a commit to fix that.

Ava: Thanks. Anything else before I merge the docs PR after legal ack? :thumbsup:

Raj: Approved pending minor wording tweak I pushed as a suggestion on the PR. No blockers from legal.

Elena: I'll wait for Raj's suggestion to be accepted then merge.

Ava: Great — merging after the small tweak. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
